g.text: Figure 6A Use Case Specification — UC-01 to UC-03
1. RCA creates the engagement and enters the client
2. A2 ClientIntel runs ACC-04 (ASIC registration status,
ABN validity) and ACC-05 court records (when O-02
is enabled) and builds the acceptance scorecard.
3. A2 calls the LLM for ACC-03 background risk scoring
and ACC-02 independence threat evaluation, reading
4. A1 Orchestrator pauses at the gate; A10 ConciergeAgent
presents the scorecard and reasoning chain; RCA
performs ACC-01 (accept or not); A10 writes the decision.
5. On acceptance A2 runs ACC-08: acceptable reporting
written consent to appointment and s328A validity;
A1 pauses at the gate, RCA confirms, A10 writes.
6. A2 runs ACC-09: identifies those charged with governance,
decides whether all are involved in management, and
schedules the planning and completion communications
7. A2 creates or updates the client profile and writes
2a. Change of auditor and ACC-07 not complete -> ACC-01
cannot be confirmed; predecessor unreachable -> reason
4a. RCA judges the information insufficient -> names
5a. RCA declines -> reason recorded; engagement archived
client_profile_ref written, phase P1; declined -> Declined.
1. A3 IngestAgent ingests the accounting system feed, the draft
statements and uploaded files into FinancialDataStore and
FinancialStatements; runs PLN-24 JE population completeness
check and PLN-12 data quality check.
2. A4 RiskAssessor runs PLN-07 preliminary analytics with the P0
scorecard and client profile, PLN-17 internal control and ITGC,
PLN-20 laws and regulations, PLN-21 prior estimates, PLN-23
service organisations; on a first engagement A6 FieldworkAgent
3. A4 runs PLN-04: rules enumerate material accounts x assertions
into the AuditObjective baseline; the LLM rates each, writes the
basis and suggested procedures, and may propose objectives
4. A1 Orchestrator pauses at the gate; A10 ConciergeAgent presents
PLN-01 proposed values and the objective list; RCA confirms overall
and performance materiality and the clearly trivial threshold, and
confirms or edits each objective and RiskItem; A10 submits one
GateDecision (edits[]) via DecisionSubmit; A1 checks the version
5. A4 runs PLN-16 financial-statement-level risks and overall response
and PLN-18 (substantive procedures alone sufficient?); RCA confirms
6. A1 assembles procedures per objective by risk level, sets parameters,
generates unpredictability candidates, writes procedures.json and
runs the coverage rules; gaps listed -> back to step 4.
7. A1 creates AuditPlan vN (draft, packSnapshot); A4 writes its
8. A10 presents vN; RCA approves; the GateDecision bound to vN is
submitted via DecisionSubmit; A1 checks version and gate state;
vN is set approved and the engagement enters P2.
1a. Data quality check fails -> AwaitingData; RCA is notified to request
data from the Client; retries exhausted -> UC-09 via extend (c).
4a. RCA changes a risk level -> reason recorded, RiskItem version +1.
8a. Version stale -> current version re-presented; rejected -> vN+1
materiality and RiskItems confirmed; AuditPlan vN
approved with procedures.json; engagement in P2.
1. A1 Orchestrator fans out A6 instances per the schedule
2. A6 reads the GEN-05 YAML and binds parameters rule by rule;
RuleEngine runs the SQL on FinancialDataStore.
3. Each result row is wrapped as an Exception carrying an
4. For GEN-02 exception attribution (hybrid), A6 calls the LLM for
a candidate explanation and reasoning chain per Exception.
5. Judgments that hit a GEN-09 trigger rule are reviewed by A7
ReviewAgent: first pass on evidence pointers only, second pass
compares; writes critic_verdict, critic_reason_type, reason and the
independent conclusion with its reasoning chain (validated per 8.6).
Inconsistent for insufficient evidence -> Loop 1, back to step 4;
other reasons or Loop 1 exhausted -> dispute item for the human
queue. Judgments not hit are marked skipped.
6. Instances put Judgment, Exception, ProcedureRun and ReviewTask
drafts in a StatePatch; A1 validates and merges into
AuditOutputStore and publishes the tasks to ReviewQueue; the rest
close automatically; procedures whose period is covered are completed.
4a. LLM output malformed -> schema check fails -> 2 retries -> still
failing: rule result kept, unattributed ReviewTask created for
AuditOutputStore; ReviewTasks needing a human in ReviewQueue.
